name: USPTO_patent_number_to_application
description: Convert any patent number format to a USPTO application number. Accepts grant numbers (US9629826B2, 9629826), application numbers (14/966,067), and publication numbers (US20160106718A1). Returns the application number plus basic metadata (title, dates, status). Use this FIRST before calling any other USPTO patent tool --- they all require application numbers as input.

patent_number.description: Patent number in any format: grant (US9629826B2), application (14/966,067), or publication (US20160106718A1)

applicationNumberText.description: The USPTO application number (primary key for all other tools)
